title: CC3220SF Digital Twin Telemetry Packet v1.1.0
description: Frozen schema for the authenticated telemetry packet produced by the merged CpE-1 + CpE-2 firmware on the CC3220SF. Version 1.1.0 is the Spring 2026 Week 10 integration baseline. The JSON shape is backward-compatible with v1.0.0 (pwm_duty_us and pwm_period_us are optional additions to the telemetry object). v1.1.0 widens the HMAC canonical string to bind the PWM fields; receivers default missing PWM fields to 0 so v1.0.0 packets without them continue to validate.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this packet format. Excluded from the HMAC canonical string for backward compatibility.

device_id.description: Unique device identifier. Included in the HMAC canonical string.

seq_num.description: Monotonically increasing packet counter (uint32). Resets to 1 on device reboot.

timestamp_ms.description: Monotonic board time in milliseconds sourced from FreeRTOS xTaskGetTickCount(). Resets on reboot.

temperature_c.description: Temperature reading in degrees Celsius, one decimal place (%.1f format).

humidity.description: Relative humidity percentage, one decimal place (%.1f format).

pwm_duty_us.description: Vibration motor PWM duty cycle in microseconds. Optional v1.1.0 addition. Range 7000-10000 us at 100 Hz period in nominal operation.

pwm_period_us.description: Vibration motor PWM period in microseconds. Optional v1.1.0 addition. Fixed at 10000 us (100 Hz) in current firmware.

hmac.description: HMAC-SHA256 hex digest (64 chars) computed over the canonical string: device_id|seq_num|timestamp_ms|temperature_c|humidity|pwm_duty_us|pwm_period_us. The schema_version field is NOT included. v1.1.0 widens the canonical string to bind the PWM fields so motor-command tampering is also caught by the integrity check; receivers default missing PWM fields to 0 (preserves backward compat with v1.0.0 packets that never had them).
